protocol.a2a: 1.0-only official SDK1.1.0 JSONRPC HTTP handler; default context builder; no legacy compatibility

namespaces.task: Amir opaque tk_ handle; native IDs are public only if a captured MCP content metadata/history path reveals them
namespaces.context: Amir opaque cx_ handle; public native metadata/history paths separately recorded
namespaces.scope: Isolated official-handler loopback service with unchanged disclosed authored executor

fixture.kind: Separate authored A2A1.0 port of official Carol application

instrumentation.native_http: Read-only preload wraps original bridge fetch; captures exact supplied request/body and cloned response entity bytes; does not alter headers, parameters or transport.
instrumentation.overhead: Cloned response body is logged before original response is delivered; capture file I/O and scheduling overhead included, no latency or efficiency claim.
instrumentation.native_bytes: Fetch-visible application entity bytes, excludes TCP framing and implicit HTTP headers.
instrumentation.cleanup: Specific recorded children only; preload IPC emits unchanged original CLI SIGTERM shutdown handler and awaits actual exit; Carol IPC invokes server.close.
instrumentation.inherited_preload_labels: Logger uses historical authored-port labels. Actual service is the official Express handler, not the earlier custom HTTP wrapper.

claim_limit: Bounded official-handler bridge fidelity using disclosed authored executor; no C1 novelty, second domain, natural failure prevalence, inverse mapping or human scientific review.
